items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: We had quite a few blues singers around Kansas City by that time, but they all to us seemed like they were poor imitations of Jimmy Rushing and George Turner.

ctx.x: Maybe four or five years ago. But Brown was, like, he was a total stranger to us. I don't know how or when or where Mashann got him, Johnny Tumino got him or who got him. We had quite a few blues singers around Kansas City by that time, but they all to us seemed like they were poor imitations of Jimmy Rushing and George Turner.
